g.text: Where GENCO goes wrong, and how its response differs

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'TeX Gyre Heros'; fill: #57564f

g.text: Its errors grow when outages cluster in one area, as storms and wildfires do. Its response to system-wide load

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'TeX Gyre Heros'; fill: #57564f

g.text: growth is systematically weaker than AC's, until fine-tuning supervises that response.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'TeX Gyre Heros'; text-anchor: start; fill: #8d8c86

g.text: a: `clustered_outages`, 42 to 60 cases per group; bars: medians. b: `load_response`, `load_response_finetuned`, 129 held-out scenarios, ±2 %; lines: median slopes.
